title: HR read PDP transport definitions v1
$comment: Structural constraints only. The strict wire parser also enforces UTF-8, duplicate rejection, canonical JSON number spelling, Int64 history revisions, byte/depth limits and equality to the configured route and tuple. Authentication, current central authority and freshness require the named runtime boundaries.

epochSeconds.description: UTC Unix seconds. Request timestamps require plain canonical decimal JSON with at most seven fractional digits; the runtime rejects exponents, negative zero and trailing fractional zero spellings.

tokenExpiresAt.description: Signed subject-token exp in whole UTC Unix seconds; independently matched to the authenticated subject token.

tokenSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact compact subject token bytes, excluding the Bearer prefix. This is not a raw token or an authentication proof.

historyTarget.description: Runtime additionally enforces a positive Int64 revision at most 9223372036854775807 and an exact canonical nonzero consumer UUID.

rawTarget.description: Exact GET RawTarget. No query, fragment, URL escaping, normalization, trailing slash or alternate casing. Its tenant must equal consumerTenantId at runtime.

ownership.description: Exact current central-registration ownership. Platform ownership has no owning tenant. Tenant ownership requires ownerTenantId equal to owner; runtime correlates that equality and registered product ID.

allocationScope.description: Single consumer, organization-fabric product, configured environment and exclusive HR read group. Runtime equality to the configured tuple is required.
